nodes.label: Fallback News Image
nodes.description: Action photograph of multiple German firefighters (Feuerwehr) in full protective gear — dark navy turnout jackets with yellow retroreflective stripes, yellow SCBA (self-contained breathing apparatus) tanks on their backs, and yellow helmets with face shields. Four or more firefighters are seen from behind and in profile, advancing through smoky debris at what appears to be a fire aftermath or active incident scene. The ground is covered with rubble and charred material; smoke fills the background. The mood is serious, intense, and documentary. Text 'FEUERWEHR' is visible on several jackets. Used as a generic fallback/placeholder image for news articles on the KFV Freising website.

nodes.label: News Fallback Role
nodes.description: This image serves as the default fallback thumbnail/hero image for news entries in the georgringer/news TYPO3 extension when no specific image is provided for an article.
